info.title: Japan Corporate-Number (法人番号) API
info.description: Look up, search, and name-match Japanese corporations against the official 国税庁 (National Tax Agency) corporate-number registry. x402-enabled for AI agents doing KYC, vendor reconciliation (名寄せ), invoice verification, or company research in Japan.

get.summary: Look up a Japanese corporation by corporate number
get.description: Look up one Japanese (JP) company by its 13-digit corporate number (法人番号) — official trade name (Japanese and registered English), registered address, postal code, corporation kind, and lifecycle status. `status` is "active" or "closed"; a closed record carries the closure cause/date and the successor's 法人番号 after a merger. Sourced from the 国税庁 (National Tax Agency) corporate-number public dataset. The leading check digit is validated before lookup.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

post.summary: Verify a company name against the JP registry (KYB)
post.description: Reconcile a company name (+ optional address) against the official Japanese (JP) corporate registry — the 名寄せ / KYC endpoint. Returns ranked candidate 法人番号 with a 0-1 confidence score, handling 株式会社 / (株) / ㈱ spelling variation and matching Japanese or English names. A dissolved corporation is never reported as `verified` even on an exact name match — check `best.corporation.status`. Use it to confirm a vendor, customer, or invoice counterparty.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

name.description: Corporation name to reconcile against the registry. Required.

corporate_number.description: A 法人番号 the caller wants confirmed against the name/address. Optional.

example.name: 株式会社サンプル商事

post.summary: Search the Japanese corporate registry by name
post.description: Search the Japanese (JP) corporate registry by trade name and/or location. Partial-name match on both the Japanese and registered English name, with width/abbreviation normalization, filterable by prefecture, city, and corporation kind. Returns up to 50 corporations with their 法人番号 and lifecycle status. Dynamic pricing: a base fee plus a small per-result fee.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

name.description: Partial trade-name match (商号の部分一致). Width/abbreviation normalized.

prefecture.description: Prefecture name ("東京都") or JIS prefecture code ("13").

post.summary: Look up corporate numbers in bulk (up to 100)
post.description: Look up many Japanese (JP) corporate numbers (法人番号) in one request (up to 50). Dynamic pricing by item count with a volume discount.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

items.description: Corporate numbers to look up in one call (max 50). Each item has an `id` (echoed back) and a 13-digit `corporate_number`.
